entities.summary: Sonam Dolma Brauen (b. 1953-01-30, Kongpo) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kongpo and Switzerland. Known in the fields of switzerland, painters & sculptors, europe.
